review: Inspected actual retained 28-bone model: side preparation f19, three-quarter airborne f49, front loaded landing f89. Pelvis lateral loading remains under a stationary planar root; knees flex with soles planted, asymmetric legs tuck in flight, spine/chest and free arm overlap. Original mesh, hierarchy/rest/bind and 1.85s/60FPS source windows preserved. Numeric validation passes with supporting sole drift below0.5micrometres.
limitations: Accepted for isolated native Unity import at FIRST PASS only. Native retargeting, actual right-hand stick, continuous joint arcs, real moving supports and integration retiming remain to be reviewed. Not final approval.
